text:
elaine: Heads up - Regulatory asks: can we show (1) a sample SAML assertion that maps to RBAC, (2) the service-account rotation procedure, and (3) a single-row audit proving MFA was honored for a hosted user? Need by EOD.

rafi: I can assemble the SAML assertion and the MFA audit row. Quick note: we accept SAML 2.0/OIDC, map attributes to roles (email/groups/entitlements). For hosted customers we enforce MFA for org-admins by default and log authn_context in audit entries.

 taylor: I'll draft the rotation + revoke blurb. TL;DR: signing keys are KMS-backed, daily automated rotation, tokens are short-lived (1h default) and revocable via the revocation API; emergency revokes trigger immediate invalidation + audit entry.

elaine: Can we also get a tiny RBAC snippet that shows least-privilege? They like YAML examples.

rafi: SAML sample (paste):
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="groups"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="entitlements"><AttributeValue>redwood:viewer</AttributeValue></Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

rafi: MFA audit curl (org-admin):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" "https://console.redwood/api/audit?filter=event:authentication.success AND mfa:true&limit=1"
```

infra-bot: export ready: /exports/finreg/idp_assertion_row_1779994321.csv (presigned link valid 48h)

 taylor: RBAC YAML snippet:
```
roles:
  - id: viewer
    permissions: [models.read, logs.read]
service_accounts:
  - id: poc-runner
    scopes: [models.read]
    token_ttl_seconds: 3600
```

elaine: Perfect. Please upload ZIP with SAML XML, RBAC YAML, the infra-bot CSV link, and a one-paragraph rotation note. I'll review and send to the customer.
